sources.author: George Lasry
sources.title: A Methodology for the Cryptanalysis of Classical Ciphers with Search Metaheuristics
findings: Strict local improvement may stall; restarting or accepting a non-improving move may escape but can return immediately to the same local maximum.

ILS alternates a procedure reaching local optima with a perturbation procedure escaping them. The author distinguishes generic ILS from his nested different-key-part scheme and calls for research on cryptanalytic ILS.
Simulated annealing offers another escape mechanism but needs temperature/cooling choices. This phase deliberately avoids tuning a temperature.

sources.author: CrypTool2 Team
sources.finding: Previously audited source-neighbourhood is reused verbatim.

experimental_choices.policy: Greedy ILS-inspired perturbation then HC; retain best IDP globally
experimental_choices.kick_strength: Fixed cycle 2,3,4 disjoint point swaps; sample 2k distinct positions uniformly by shuffle; no canceling swaps
experimental_choices.HC: Previously audited circular-slide/segment-swap/three-partite source neighbourhood, random sweep order, strict improvement
experimental_choices.acceptance: Non-improving post-perturbation starting score is permitted; after HC the global incumbent changes only if IDP improves. Therefore may revisit the same maximum; returns are logged. No tabu rule.
experimental_choices.comparison: Same observed wrong numeric K2, stream seed, global max IDP evaluations and secondary wall-time cap for restart and kick. Source strict checks one optimum then stops.
experimental_choices.score_budget: Every in-solver IDP evaluation is gated, including initial score and single evaluation after an entire kick. Applying unscored swaps is not an IDP evaluation. Event totals must equal budget count.
experimental_choices.truth: Planted key/plaintext and exact success appear only outside solver in synthetic control generator and metrics.
experimental_choices.observed_case: Conditioned diagnostic, not new independent calibration; starting wrong K2 taken from the15s completed phase4 HC output.
experimental_choices.walk_variant: Accept every reached local optimum as current state, even if worse; maintain separate best-ever record. Same 2/3/4 disjoint-swap cycle and source HC, global150000 IDP evaluations/15s. Additional diagnostic only.
experimental_choices.calibration_decision: No fresh calibration or historical attempt: all tested policies retain the same wrong incumbent on the conditioned case. This is not a universal rejection of ILS or of key regions.
